system.description:
Attack Action: roll a Skill Die. Grit: gain the Warrior's Tough (when hit, roll a Skill Die; Grit cuts the damage by 1) for the next 3 Combat Rounds. Wit: +1 Move Action this Combat Turn and your next. Smarts: learn an enemy's Weakness or get tactical advice from the Director. Heart: enemies won't target or harm you for 1 Combat Round. Strange: 6 Soul damage to all enemies within Medium Range (50 ft), Doom +5. Luck: choose the effect. Outside combat the Director decides the effect.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.65

automation.note: Roll one Skill Die and apply: Grit - for 3 Combat Rounds, when hit roll a Skill Die and reduce the damage by 1 on Grit. Wit - one extra Move Action this turn and next (the action tracker doesn't count it). Smarts - the Director reveals a Weakness or gives advice. Heart - enemies ignore you for 1 Combat Round. Strange - 6 Soul to every enemy within 50 ft and Doom +5. Luck - pick any of these.
